caption: The drawing depicts a single, three-dimensional object positioned towards the left side of the composition, leaving a large portion of the background as empty, off-white space. The object appears to be a distressed, approximately triangular or wedge-shaped piece of dark brown wood, with two irregular, worn patches of a lighter, yellowish-brown color on its upper surface. Along the upper edge are three large, curved, white or ivory-colored claw or tusk-like projections that emerge at different angles. On the lower edge of the object are a series of round, blackish knobs or studs, and attached near one corner is a large, circular metal ring. To the right of the main object, there are faint graphite pencil notes and lines, as well as several scattered brush strokes or color tests in brown, purple, gray, and cream tones along the right and lower edges of the paper. The background remains largely unpainted except for some subtle shadows cast by the object and the ring.
title: Carving: Boar's Head
